text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Fine. ...That was a 
dazzling run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating, but... you really do 
run an amazing race."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's a shame. Now we won't get a chance 
for revenge.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling lonely, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Parting with my roommate is drawing 
near. Am I so cold-blooded that feeling 
sentimental is unfitting for me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true! If anything, I might 
be the cold-blooded one...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Rather than feeling lonely together, it 
made me happy. Knowing that I truly became 
a precious 'memory' to them."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That I can remain inside Groove-san's 
memories. That makes me happy... Does that 
sound cold?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... You've been that kind of person 
from the very start. But I'm not the only 
one who became just a memory.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!! Fine Motion, Fine...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
"Fine Motiooooon!! *sniff*... 
Waaaahhhhh~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You can hear it, can't you? Your memory 
will live on in everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's not out of sentimentality. That's 
just how strong... you were.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove-san...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I love you, my revered "Empress."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...! We're done talking. Hurry up and do 
what you need to do!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yeah. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm home, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: We still have time, don't we?
We still have time, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can still run anywhere, and as far as we 
want... with you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Until the day our true farewell awaits. 
Let's make the best memories together!
